name: illustration-globe-vercel

frames.best_why: The most accent paths and node rings are lit at once, with the deployed badge showing underneath.

tagline: Wireframe hemisphere with glowing deploy paths arcing down to node dots.
summary: A half-globe drawn in thin lines, with coloured paths that travel from the north pole down to small circular nodes and ring out as they land. A small badge underneath reports whether the deploy is running, done or failed.
appearance: A faint grey hemisphere on a near-black stage, made of one round outline, several vertical meridians and nine latitude lines. Six small circles sit at path endpoints, and a compact light pill with a status word and replay icon is centred below the globe.
behaviour: Accent-coloured paths draw themselves from the pole down to each node in turn, and a circle at each landing point swells into a fading ring. The status pill can read deploying, deployed or failed, and its replay icon restarts the whole sequence.
demo_content: Status pills Deploying, Deployed and Failed, four accent dots, and a badge reading deployed or deploying…
search_phrases: animated lines radiating from a point
dark diagram of a half sphere
tech illustration for a deploy section
use_when: A deploy or infrastructure section needs a compact visual of routes reaching nodes with a pass or fail state.
avoid_when: It is decoration, not data: paths are fixed trajectories and the wireframe density is hardcoded.
customise: Status, accent colour, duration, the node list and a replay callback are props; the globe geometry and wireframe density are fixed constants.
weight_why: A few dozen SVG lines animated by SMIL opacity and radius; no canvas, WebGL or JS frame loop.

a11y.note: The drawing is aria-hidden and the replay button has a label, but nothing checks reduced-motion and the button has no visible focus style.

issues: The grey wireframe is very faint against the dark stage, so the latitude lines nearly vanish.
The status badge and control text are tiny at the recorded size.
polish_why: Precise geometry and smooth path draws; faint lines and small badge text hold it back.
title: Deploy Globe
